note: Sign positions measured Day 14, 26 Aug, by clicking the FLOOR at the base of the wall each sign is mounted on, in an undistorted clip1 frame, converted through homography_camC.npz. Five clicks along the sign wall agreed on y to within 1 cm (1.64-1.65 m), so the y figure is a measurement, not a single reading. Hardcoded rather than OCR'd: signage OCR was cut on Day 12 and the sign text was known in advance, so only the reading is manual - the audit is unaffected.

signs.absent_note: TOILETS and LOUNGE were deliberately omitted at shoot time to generate genuine wayfinding uncertainty. Trips categorised MISSING are those whose destination is absent from this sign.
